headline: Deep learning applied to cryo-EM maps, conformational ensembles and assembly simulation
label: Deep Learning Macromolecular Structure
summary: Recent preprints extend transformer and diffusion architectures to cryo-EM maps and conformational ensembles of macromolecules.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the application of learned representations to three-dimensional macromolecular structure, with most items addressing experimental cryo-EM processing or conformational analysis. Point Transformer, a self-attention point-cloud network, is applied to cryo-EM data to analyze conformational heterogeneity with improved interpretability. DEMO-EMReF, a Swin Transformer with hybrid spatial and channel attention, refines density maps and improves map-model correlation. Diffusion models appear in two items: distance-restraint-guided sampling of conformational changes and ligand dissociation pathways built on Boltz-2, and DiffEnsemble, conditioned on AlphaFold structural profiles to generate ensembles. Generative design yields rigid fiducials for GPCR cryo-EM. What is new is the pairing of architecture-level advances in cryo-EM processing with generative and conditioned models for conformational ensembles. The set does not establish a unifying method beyond this framing; the self-assembly simulation and lipid nanoparticle database items are adjacent rather than central.
